integrity: The central identities are exact for dyadic terminal counts and are independently replayed by the packaged checker. The asymptotic statements follow from standard binomial bounds and Stirling asymptotics; numerical checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The result diagnoses an inconsistency inside the displayed complexity derivation. It does not prove the algorithm itself subexponential, does not prove Theorem 4 false, and does not reconstruct costs that may be absent from the displayed model.
title: An indexing mismatch in the polynomial-space quantum Steiner-tree tradeoff
